# The Ridge Bounty

*Skarra pays the trail watch's bounty for the High Ridges: 60 of the ridges' stumps, any time.*

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Town | [Midbarium](../towns/midbarium_quests.md) |
| Category | Repeatable |
| Given by | [Skarra](../npcs/skarra_uskari.md) |
| Level | 21 |
| After | [Red Dots](../quests/skarra_red_dots.md) |

## Objectives

- Defeat 60 High Ridges monsters ([Gnarled Stump](../monsters/gnarled_stump.md), [Axe Stump](../monsters/axe_stump.md), [Dark Axe Stump](../monsters/dark_axe_stump.md))

## Rewards

- 5,500 EXP
- 420 mesos
- +20 standing with Midbarium

The first time you complete it instead: 7,000 EXP, 840 mesos, [Orange Potion](../items/orange_potion.md) x20, +15 standing with Midbarium, +30 standing with [Skarra](../npcs/skarra_uskari.md)
